relationship: Editing and running Python lesson code connects a challenge prompt to console output and automated checking.

learnerLoop.action: Choose a lesson, edit or load code, run it and check the challenge.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The active program, runtime state and challenge progress change.
learnerLoop.evidence: The editor, console, status and checker feedback show what the code did.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Debug the program or progress to the next challenge.

invariants: Challenge feedback evaluates the current challenge code.
Console evidence belongs to the active program run.
safeAdaptations: Change lesson examples, prompts or starter code while retaining editable execution and challenge checking.
nonGoals: Serving as a general-purpose Python development environment.
